items.title: Indonesia deploys troops to Jakarta after wiretapping allegations
items.description: Indonesian troops are being stationed in Jakarta amid wiretapping allegations implicating the president's chief of staff. Suspects are being accused of illegally tapping the president's phones.

items.title: Japan faces diplomatic dilemma amid joint pressure from nuclear neighbors
items.description: As the Ukraine war grinds on, ties between Russia and neighboring Japan are at their worst in decades. Tokyo wants more support from Washington, but some Japanese are concerned they may not get it.

items.title: World News in Brief: Children killed in Myanmar strike, new violence flares in Mozambique, an Internet affordability milestone
items.description: A school in Myanmar has been hit in an airstrike, with three children reported killed and five others injured, according to UN Children’s Fund UNICEF.

items.title: Ukrainian Crowd Clashes With Riot Police, Again Highlighting Recruitment Tactics, Military Morale
items.description: A crowd clashed with police and National Guard troops in a Kyiv suburb amid allegations that men were being held and tortured in a private house. The incident highlights growing tensions over Ukraine’s controversial military recruitment practices as it strives to repel Russia’s full-scale invasion.
